_comment: Positions are the gripper TCP in the world frame, mm. Record destinations with: python record_pose.py <name>

overview._comment: overview-cam calibration grid (world mm) and fingertip heights above the table; see overview.py
overview._grid: where the overview-cam sees the claws whole (it sits on the -y side looking toward +y; at y<=0 the claws leave the frame)

grasp._tcp_to_tip: how far the real fingertips reach past the gripper TCP (arm + 150 mm). motion_probe.py --touch on 2026-11-13: 10.8, stopped by the 10 mm floor just short of the paper, so the true value is ~9-11 (10.8 errs high = safe). The claws collision box reaches 50 mm: very conservative
